description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens (measured in thousands, labeled as “Tokens (K)”) across eight distinct textual categories in the SALT dataset, as referenced in the paper “Towards a More Inclusive AI Progress and Perspectives in Large Language Model Training for the Sámi Language.” The horizontal axis lists the categories in the following order from left to right: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 2,000. Each category is represented by a single light blue bar, with the exact token count labeled in blue text above each bar. The “News” category dominates the dataset with 10,584K tokens, followed by “Administrative” with 6,472K. “Non-fiction” accounts for 1,889K, “Science” for 1,626K, “Religion” for 652K, “Fiction” for 387K, “Law” for 354K, and “Blogs” has the smallest representation at just 32K tokens. The bars are not sorted by value, and no additional visual emphasis (such as shading or outlines) is applied to any specific category.
